attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS c ON cb.class_symbol_id = c.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS cf ON c.file_id = cf.file_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS b ON cb.base_symbol_id = b.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.get_columns' AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.name = 'get_columns' AND m.line_start > c.line_start AND m.line_end < c.line_end WHERE cf.is_test = FALSE AND c.kind = 'class' AND b.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND b.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND b.kind = 'class' AND m.summary_source = 'none' ORDER BY m.symbol_id

request:
Among the production database connector classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding classes in test code (any file under a tests/ folder), which ones override get_columns with their own get_columns method that has no docstring of its own (a leading # comment is not a docstring)? Return the symbol ID of each such get_columns method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query finds production connector classes that directly inherit from the SQLDatabase base class and that define their own get_columns method without a docstring. It joins class base records to the class symbols and to file metadata to exclude test files, then matches each class to its direct get_columns method and filters out methods whose documentation source is not absent. The result is returned once per matching get_columns method, ordered by symbol ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS c ON cb.class_symbol_id = c.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS cf ON c.file_id = cf.file_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS b ON cb.base_symbol_id = b.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS m ON m.file_id = c.file_id AND m.qualname = c.qualname || '.get_columns' AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.name = 'get_columns' AND m.line_start > c.line_start AND m.line_end < c.line_end WHERE cf.is_test = FALSE AND c.kind = 'class' AND b.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' AND b.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND b.kind = 'class' AND m.summary_source = 'none' ORDER BY m.symbol_id
